messages:
rene: Support flagged another "no project" ticket — gateway keys hide downstream project when proxying. We need a low-cost visibility pattern.
priya: Agreed. Can't use full eff IDs in metrics. Proposal: sampled provenance only, with compact eff_hash and per-key reservoir so low-volume keys still surface.
theo: Reservoir idea: keep first 6 events/day per key, then 0.5% tail sample. Also emit route_id + fallback_reason for each sample.
priya: eff_hash = HMAC_SHA256(eff_identity, secret)[0:10] — store only hash. Add LRU cap per-origin to bound cardinality.
rene: UX: show a small "provenance examples (sampled)" widget on key pages, with a tooltip: "Samples are for debugging; billing uses authoritative counters."
theo: Rollout: staging pilot (top 4k keys) -> monitor storage/query cost for 2 weeks -> expand. Retention 30d default, 90d for flagged keys.
ops-bot: deploy started: provenance-sampler@staging -> v0.1.0 by ci/cd at 2026-03-23T18:22:01Z
priya: Action items: I'll open PR for sampler + eff_hash lib (WIP), theo will prototype UI widget, rene will sync billing on retention/costs.
rene: Add CI guard: sampled pipeline must not feed quota/enforcement. Fail if referenced.
priya: 👍 will include tests.
